basic_profile.bio: A passionate anime and gaming enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I've been exploring the depths of both anime streaming services and modded Minecraft worlds for several years. I'm a night owl, often browsing Reddit and gaming forums between 10 PM and 2 AM. By day, I work as a freelance sound engineer, which allows me to blend my love for audio and technology. Currently single, I enjoy attending local anime conventions and occasionally dabble in zero-carb diets to stay fit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Audio Engineering and a lifelong passion for anime, I've developed a unique expertise in sound design for animation. Self-taught in the realm of Minecraft modding, I regularly engage with communities to expand my knowledge. My interest in zero-carb diets comes from personal research and experimentation.
